prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. A tall narrow building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house, seen straight on, two floors stacked. Top: a 1930s bakery kitchen at night, dark and empty, cold blue moonlight through the window, one dim bulb, flour sacks, cooling loaves on racks, a baker's apron on a hook. Between them, the thick floor cut through: floorboards, wooden joists, brick and earth. Bottom, blazing: a secret 1930s basement speakeasy that is also a mint: rows of black iron printing presses with simple faces painted on their sides throw sheets of blank green paper money with no printing on it into the air like confetti; a band of gangsters in pinstripe suits plays trumpet, double bass and drums on a little stage; a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache dances on a table. Emerald lamps hang over the presses, gold spotlights hit the stage, scarlet velvet curtains, a black-and-white tiled floor slick with spilled champagne. The basement is the bright floor; the bakery above is dark, so the eye falls down. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
